column12: Great curb appeal and the backyard is a big plus. Smaller inside than the photos make it look.
Buyers thought it needs paint and new carpet for this price. Around 470 would make more sense to them.
They asked if the neighborhood is safe at night because they heard about car break-ins nearby. Liked the open kitchen.
Buyers loved it and might write an offer this week. They are waiting to hear back from their lender first.
Kitchen is dated compared to others they've seen around 480. The buyers are Muslim and wanted to know how far the nearest mosque is.
Strong pet smell in the basement.
